title.zh: 同一个核，方向为何不同

t.zh: 打开的是 <level-ref to="1-2"></level-ref> 通关时的邻域计算电路。保留展开、乘权重、求和与还原，在核进入邻域表之前增加翻转。通关后仍更新同一个邻域处理器。
t.en: The board continues the neighbourhood circuit passed in <level-ref to="1-2"></level-ref>. Keep unfolding, weighting, reduction and restoration; add kernel reversal before the window table. Passing updates the same spatial processor.

t.zh: 处理器能处理任意核，但课程公式和一些工具使用不同的核约定。对称平滑核掩盖了差别，现在用非对称核把问题显露出来，再给自己的处理器加上明确的数学接口。 <wiki-ref to="convolution-orientation"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The processor accepts any kernel, but conventions differ. Symmetric smoothing hides that difference. Expose it with an asymmetric kernel and build an explicit mathematical interface. <wiki-ref to="convolution-orientation"></wiki-ref>

after.zh:
\[\begin{gathered}(I*K)(x,y)\\=\sum_{u,v}K(u,v)\,I(x-u,y-v)\end{gathered}\]

∗ 表示数学卷积，求和覆盖核的偏移。它与互相关的区别是邻域偏移的方向相反，等价于先翻转核。对称核翻转后不变，所以只有看非对称核，方向差别才会显现。 <wiki-ref to="convolution-orientation"></wiki-ref>
after.en:
\[\begin{gathered}(I*K)(x,y)\\=\sum_{u,v}K(u,v)\,I(x-u,y-v)\end{gathered}\]

∗ denotes mathematical convolution, summed over kernel offsets. Reversing the offset direction distinguishes it from correlation, equivalently reversing the kernel first. Symmetric kernels survive reversal unchanged; asymmetric kernels reveal the distinction. <wiki-ref to="convolution-orientation"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 接口接收数学卷积核。让非对称核的方向与卷积定义一致，保持输出尺寸和零边界。
brief.en: The interface receives mathematical convolution kernels. Match their orientation, including asymmetric kernels, with same-size output and zero boundaries.

naiveWhy.zh: 对称核不能区分两种约定；非对称亮点响应会暴露核的方向是否反转。
naiveWhy.en: Symmetric kernels hide the distinction; asymmetric impulse responses expose orientation.

hint.zh: 用非对称权重表与单个亮点检查方向。翻转核只调整权重表，不是翻转待处理图。
hint.en: Inspect an asymmetric kernel on an impulse. Reverse the weight table, not the image.

desc.zh: 运行所选形态的已通关电路，对图像应用给定核。
desc.en: Apply the supplied kernel using the passed board of the selected form.
